## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.0.0

Version 4.0.0 adds a native Windows GUI that opens by double-clicking the EXE. The PowerShell console collector remains available in the source archive for existing workflows.

The GUI watches for USB physical drives, excludes boot and system disks, reads drive identity through smartctl, and saves each record to `Output\Inventory.xlsx` beside the EXE. It also supports manual entry, copying the last record with a new serial number, duplicate checks, optional workbook columns, a session log, scanning pause, and a temporary AutoPlay setting that is restored on normal exit.

**Download:** `USB-Drive-Inventory-Collector.exe` from the release assets below. The EXE is a self-contained Windows x64 build and requests administrator access. Automatic drive identification requires smartmontools; the app asks before installing it through WinGet if it is missing. Microsoft Excel and a PowerShell execution policy change are not required for the GUI.

For the legacy console version, download the source archive and run `USB-Drive-Inventory-Collector.ps1` from an elevated PowerShell session where script execution is permitted. See the [README](https://github.com/ShannonWetnight/usb-drive-inventory-collector#readme) for usage and limitations.
